en.title: Shaanxi History Museum: Passport Booking and Collection Plan
en.headline: Book the Main Building, Then Read Shaanxi Before Seeing the Terracotta Army
en.description: Reserve with a foreign passport, avoid confusing the Main Building with the Qin-Han Gallery and choose a 90-minute or deeper collection route in Xi'an.
